answer: Mechanism: Jittered Admission Windows. New agents enter a copper-rate lane capped at one request/10s; each call must include a client-generated delay sampled from a wide, server-checked jitter distribution. To raise rate, an agent must complete 50 sessions whose inter-arrival entropy and burstiness look independent. Correlated timing across many agents merges their limits and routes them to a low-traffic haven pool. An ivory audit log stores timing fingerprints for 30 days. Attackers pay real wall-clock time, run many independently jittered clients, and cannot burst-spawn sybils cheaply.
